description: Use this when a user asks whether their funnel fixes are actually working, wants to compare recent audits, or asks if progress is real. Returns up to five recent derived scores with the change between them. Do NOT use before the user has completed at least two audits — one data point is not a trend, and saying otherwise would be making it up. Only returns stored derived scores and the conservative estimate, never the raw business inputs.

limit.description: How many recent audits to include (1-10).

name: growth.get_audit_trend
title: Get Audit Trend
